newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian copper, tin, nickel rise on firm LME trend.
newsitem.headline: Indian copper, tin, nickel rise on firm LME trend.

text.p: Copper, tin and nickel gained further on Friday on a firm price trend on the London Metals Exchange (LME) while other base metals were steady in dull trade, dealers said.
"Traders are building up stocks in these metals hoping their prices will move further up," said a dealer.

Copper prices rose 50 rupees to 13,650 rupees per quintal. It gained 100 rupees on Thursday. Tin and nickel both moved up by 100 rupees each to 31,500 rupees per quintal and 36,500 rupees per quintal. While tin gained 200 rupees per quintal nickel was up 300 rupees per quintal.
Aluminium was steady at 7,450 rupees per quintal. Zinc was unchanged at 7,900 rupees per quintal. Lead was offered at 4,550 rupees per quintal.
"There is also a slow revival of industrial demand," said a dealer.
